segments.he: גְּמָ׳ הָא לְתוֹפְרָן בְּגִידִין וּלְטַמֵּא אֶת הַיָּדַיִם — זֶה וָזֶה שָׁוִין.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara infers «that» with regard «to the matter of stitching» the sheets of parchment «with sinews, and» with regard «to rendering the hands» of one who touches them «impure,» both «this,» Torah scrolls, «and that,» phylacteries and mezuzot, are «equal.» The Sages issued a decree rendering the hands of one who touches sacred scrolls impure with second-degree ritual impurity.

moves.summary: infers equality in stitching and hand impurity

edges.about: the mishna implies scrolls, tefillin and mezuzot are alike in sinew-stitching and rendering hands impure

positions.claim: both are stitched with sinews and render hands impure
